Semantic validator feedback: Repair the deterministic vocabulary failure by moving generated shape IRIs out of the canonical nltl vocabulary namespace (for example, retain them under the existing urn:nltl:generated-shape namespace); do not invent shape terms in nltl:. Semantically, do not make the pre-cutoff marking/docking alternatives conjunctively mandatory when the summer-load-line draught is not above the UIWL: gate those alternatives by the draught condition or express the conditional requirement solely through a correct bounded constraint. Also enforce that the ice-class draught mark amidships equals the class certificate's maximum ice-class draught amidships, rather than checking only mark presence. Preserve the supplied assessmentDate and the stated pre-cutoff deadline logic.

Repair the pre-cutoff deadline logic: when marking evidence is absent and firstScheduledDryDockingDate is supplied, require that date to be on or after the fixed cutoff 2007-07-01, because the regulation requires the first scheduled dry docking after 1 July 2007. Preserve the existing supplied assessmentDate-based condition, complete marking evidence alternative, certificate/document obligations, draught-direction check, and mark-to-certificate amidships comparison. No vocabulary matcher is needed.

Reject: the candidate uses qudt:numericValue with sh:datatype xsd:decimal throughout, but no canonical datatype for qudt:numericValue is supplied; remove this guessed datatype constraint or use the explicitly verified datatype. Also add direct datatype validation for the supplied firstScheduledDryDockingDate (xsd:date) and validate the ship-owned marking properties (warningTrianglePresent and iceClassDraughtMarkPresent) and the ship-owned iceClassDraughtMarkDraughtAmidships quantity outside only the conditional SPARQL checks, preserving the existing applicability and deadline logic.

Repair the remaining semantic and datatype issues. Add sh:datatype xsd:date to firstScheduledDryDockingDate, preserving its conditional optionality. Constrain iceClass to its supplied canonical range nltl:iceClassValue rather than only sh:nodeKind sh:IRI. Gate the mark-to-certificate amidships comparison by the applicable summer-load-line/UIWL and construction/docking marking conditions; the current second SPARQL constraint rejects an out-of-scope ship merely because an optional mark is present with a different value. Preserve the supplied assessmentDate, certificate/document obligations, draught direction, fixed 2007-07-01 cutoff, pre-cutoff docking-date requirement, and complete marking alternatives.
